backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining QuoteRequest and CustomerReview types with CRUD operations, including submission, retrieval, filtering by name/service, and validation for 1-5 star ratings.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features related to the ReviewsSection component, including form creation, React Query hooks, and review display functionality.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing components, styling, and functionality including navigation, hero, services, about, reviews, contact sections, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes, featuring concrete-inspired grays and copper accent colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and title 'NewGate Concrete Coating'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component rendering Navigation, HeroSection, ServicesSection, AboutSection, ReviewsSection, ContactSection, and Footer in sequence.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component displaying four benefit cards with icons, service areas (Orlando, Tampa, Plant City) with MapPin badges, and company value proposition for polyaspartic coating services.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form component with validation for name, email, phone, service type dropdown, and message fields that submits quote requests to the backend actor with success state handling.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying company info, social media links, quick navigation buttons, contact details, and service areas for NewGate Concrete Coating. Includes copyright notice and smooth scrolling to page sections.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section component featuring a full-screen background image with overlay, company name, service description, phone CTA, and action buttons for requesting quotes and viewing services. Includes animated scroll indicator.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation bar with logo, menu links, and CTA button that becomes sticky with backdrop blur on scroll. Includes mobile hamburger menu with smooth scrolling to page sections.
frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.t: Reviews section with a form for submitting customer reviews (name, service type, star rating, feedback) and a display of all submitted reviews sorted by timestamp. Uses React Query mutations and queries for data management.
Services section displaying four polyaspartic coating services (patio, driveway, pool deck, garage) in a responsive grid with images, descriptions, and feature tags. Cards have hover effects and animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages an Internet Computer actor instance based on authentication state, using React Query for caching and automatically invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating quote requests and customer reviews using the backend actor, with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for a concrete-coating themed color palette using OKLCH colors, including copper accents, concrete neutrals, and dark mode support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with custom OKLCH-based color system for copper/concrete palette, custom animations, typography, and container query plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a NewGate Concrete Coating business website with features for hero section, services showcase, contact forms, and review system backed by Motoko canister storage.
